messages:
olivia: Heads-up — need final decision on MVP cutline & early-exit criteria for Q3 launch. Customer pilot next week; if blockers pile we'll trim.

kai: Can we get a prioritized cutlist? I think embeddings-cache + tenant-routing are heavy.

maria: Agree on cutting non-blocking UI polish. Keep admin workflows for pilot.

zane: Customers told us they need SSO + SAML to feel confident. If we can't hit that, they want a private beta.

jamie: From infra POV, main risk is peak concurrency for embedding-heavy flows. We can mitigate with higher reserved capacity for 48h.

olivia: Proposed cutlist: remove Playground advanced share, delay audit-logs export v1, keep SSO, keep embeddings cache but quantize model. Thoughts?

kai: Quantize seems ok; perf team: we should test p90 before committing. If p90>250ms, we flip to model-bypass (cheaper smaller model) for non-critical paths.

maria: UX: admin export is used by two pilot customers; if we cut we must add "manual export" workaround. Doable.

zane: Customer asks: SSO mandatory, audit-logs is optional. I'll renegotiate, but need clarity on fallback policy.

olivia: Need an "early-exit" checklist for go/no-go. Draft:

```
- SSO auth working for pilot tenant
- No more than 1 Sev-1 regressions in last 72h
- P90 gen latency < 250ms on pilot traffic
- Embeddings accuracy regression < 2% on eval set
- Rollback path and canary configured in release pipeline
```

kai: Suggest add "rate-limiting and quota checks pass" and "cost-per-1k-tokens within 10% of target".

jamie: release-bot: canary policy ready. (bot message) release-bot: Canary window=30m, traffic split=5%, auto-rollback on error_rate>5%.

olivia: OK confirm we adopt these as the official early-exit criteria. Action items: kai run p90 perf test by EOD, jamie set temporary reserved capacity for pilot, zane confirm SSO scope with customer. I'll update PRD.

zane: I'll confirm tonight and post customer's reply here.

maria: I'll prepare the minimal admin export flow copy for the workaround.

kai: Running load test now: posting results in this thread in ~3h.

olivia: Thanks team. If any major blockers flag @olivia and @jamie. :thumbsup:
